title: Understanding the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function, denoted as sigma, is used to model probabilities. It transforms any real-valued number into a value between $$0$$ and $$1$$. This is useful for predicting probabilities in binary classification problems.

title: Calculating the Linear Combination
text: To find the linear combination for Billywine, substitute the given values into the expression $$\theta_1 hue+\theta_2 abv$$. Remember, $$\theta_1$$ is $$2$$, hue is $$\frac{1}{4}$$, $$\theta_2$$ is $$1$$, and abv is $$-2$$.

title: Compute the Linear Combination
text: What is the result of the linear combination $$2\frac{1}{4}+1\left(-2\right)$$?

title: Applying the Logistic Function
text: Once you have the linear combination, apply the logistic function: $$sigma(x)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-x\right)}}$$. Use the result from the previous step as $$x$$.
